python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img65 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0065.png')
# At each column c from 160 to 220, where is the floor-wall boundary, and where does the sofa touch the floor?
# Floor color: BGR ~ [113-135, 126-150, 132-158] (note: red > green > blue)
# Sofa color: BGR ~ [117-125, 109-115, 104-110] (blue > green > red)
# Wall color: [255, 255, 255]

for c in range(160, 220, 5):
    col = img65[:, c]
    # find all sofa rows
    diff = col[:, 0].astype(int) - col[:, 2].astype(int)
    sofa_r = np.where((diff > 5) & (col[:, 0] > 90) & (col[:, 0] < 160))[0]
    # find wall-floor boundary:
    wall_r = np.where((col[:, 0] > 240) & (col[:, 1] > 240) & (col[:, 2] > 240))[0]
    floor_r = np.where((col[:, 2] > col[:, 0] + 5) & (col[:, 0] > 100))[0]
    print(f'c={c}: sofa=[{sofa_r.min() if len(sofa_r)>0 else None}, {sofa_r.max() if len(sofa_r)>0 else None}], wall_max={wall_r.max() if len(wall_r)>0 else None}, floor_min={floor_r.min() if len(floor_r)>0 else None}')
"
input.description: Trace wall-floor and sofa contacts in obs_0065
